titulo: B1 review: The B1 map, part 2 (lessons 51 to 60)

aula.objetivo: Review all of B1 in two maps, correct the most common mistakes made by English speakers at this level and practice with exercises on every topic.

blocos.titulo: B1 in one table: lessons 51 to 60
blocos.explicacao: Reread one line at a time and say an example of your own aloud.

tabela.rule: news and ad vocabulary; «selon», «d'après»; «il paraît que», «on dit que»; analysis of an advertisement.
«il faudrait que» + subjunctive; «si chacun… , l'avenir sera…»; «trier, recycler, polluer».
«voter», «élire», «le droit de»; school and political system; passive in official contexts.
me/te/se/nous/vous → le/la/les → lui/leur → y → en; imperative: «donne-le-moi»; «y» and «en» replace things.
«grâce à / à cause de»; «tellement… que»; «pour que» + subjunctive; nominalizations.
«c'est… qui/que»; «ce qui, ce que, ce dont»; «d'abord, ensuite, enfin»; «en revanche, cependant».
«il s'agit de», «raconter», «se dérouler»; recognizing the passé simple (fut, eut, fit, dit, vint).
complaint with the conditional; passive: «le vol a été annulé»; «se faire voler».
«à condition que», «à moins que», «sauf si»; reporting verbs: «annoncer, confirmer, suggérer».
cognates (-tion, -té); word families; false friends: rester, demander, attendre, exprès, sale, ignorer.

blocos.enunciado: Speak for 3 minutes in French: negotiate something (a price, a deadline) and then report the conversation to a colleague using reporting verbs.
Reread the previous table and choose the 3 topics where you still hesitate.
